_comment: Hand-curated GPU-architecture -> venv dependency matrix. Keyed by sm_XX (see detect_gpu.py). Each entry pins BOTH venvs independently because they have separately-pinned, currently-incompatible torch builds (main venv: torch2.7+cu128 for LatentSync; engines/MuseTalk/.venv: torch2.0.1+cu118, per MuseTalk's own upstream README). ONLY add an entry here once it has actually been installed and passed install/smoke_test.py on that hardware -- setup.sh refuses to guess for anything not listed. cu118-era torch generally has no PTX for archs newer than ~Hopper, so a missing 'musetalk' entry for a new architecture is not a version-bump problem -- it likely needs real changes to engines/MuseTalk's own code, budget it as its own task rather than expecting the installer to solve it.

sm_86._label: Ampere GA102/GA104 (RTX 3080, RTX 3080 Ti, RTX 3090 -- all compute capability 8.6, same pins)
_validated_on: RTX 3090 -- this machine, full install/setup.sh + smoke_test.py run
RTX 3080 Ti -- feat/update-3080ti branch (merged 2026-08-14): real production fixes developed/tested on this card against these exact pins

sm_89._label: Ada Lovelace (e.g. RTX 4090) -- NOT YET VALIDATED, same pins as sm_86 as a starting point only

sm_120._label: Blackwell (e.g. RTX 5090) -- main venv pin per render_job.py's 2026-07-23 comment; NO known-good musetalk pin
